name: hk_vor_area_shatin
requirements: Sha Tin Voronoi cell area (bbox-clipped, geodesic km²). Store shatin_cell_km2 (float, 1dp).

turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Return the area (km², 1 dp) of the Voronoi cell belonging to the Sha Tin station (station_id 11).
